channel.description: Feed for updates about my CS300 pair programming partner search

item.title: Hello people of CS300!
item.author: meng69@wisc.edu (Ethan Meng)
item.description:
Welcome! Thank you for tuning into my channel I set up in a rush. I am making a partner search page, which is probably what led you to this feed. In that case --- hi! Please subscribe to this feed because this is where I make more frequent updates, not Piazza (that's where I either put on a YES/NO for the search). Stuff you can expect to get from subscribing to this feed includes:

  • How many people have emailed me, and generally speaking how many I am considering... (it will be anonymous so rest assured)
  • Updates to the search page itself, such as new expectations...
  • My schedule, such as my exact available time, special circumstances, or other notices...

This is not a substitute for email communication: those are for more private things and the actual partnership itself. However I thought that it would help to, well, just know if a person is still available before you email them (one of the questions that get asked too often in the tiny space on Piazza).

But otherwise, yeah... I probably will take it easy on Wednesday and Thursday. But once that's over I'll put a lot more time into this! I care about anyone who wants to team up as long as you care about my values of writing GOOD code! I look forward to making this work for once :P ~EM

item.title: Piazza posted
item.author: meng69@wisc.edu (Ethan Meng)
item.description:
Huff, tuff... the hard work was done. PHEW didn't know it was that hard, I thought I had the time to write an interface for MIME encoded word encoder and figure out how to send emails using Perl's Net::SMTP, OR figure out for once what I should do with my life- I mean seas of emails... Time is just not enough man. I can't believe we're halfway through the semester already.

ANYWAYS -- I will now have to prepare for yet *another* exam tomorrow, UGH! X[ (P.S. the unit quiz we had didn't count as one.) Probably won't be responding to anything if you sent me stuff in the morning. I hope you are fine with that -- I'm not chronically on Piazza waiting for people's questions anyway.

(Now where can I find my other sock...)

item.author: meng69@wisc.edu (Ethan Meng)
item.description:
I'm back from the exam. Getting the assignment due today done will be one of my top two priorities for the rest of the day. Besides that I need sleep because I only slept for 2 hours at the library (where they didn't even like the idea that a sleep-deprived student couldn't stay awake.)

Oh, and besides that I thought I should let people know that so far nobody has reached out. My bars are too high, after all. And people don't use Piazza.

I did get Net::SMTP to work with Microsoft; one last step is to feed stdin into SMTP and I'd be able to send emails free from Microsoft's services and the Outlook storage beyond my control. Yet I've come this far... just to fight alone again. It's like school life where I knew nobody never ended......

It's okay... at least I get to close it when it's over. I'm glad that I at least posted this time. I won't regret it when I think back to this.
